variants.label: Table
variants.notes: People / System accounts / Groups tabs, table with role badges (Admin, Locked, New), group chips and last login. Same panel layout as Services. Panel on the right in all: Reset password, Lock, Delete, and tabs Info, Groups (switches), SSH keys, Sessions.

variants.label: People cards
variants.notes: Users as big square tiles like the login screen, with role and last login. Cards/Table toggle. Panel on the right in all: Reset password, Lock, Delete, and tabs Info, Groups (switches), SSH keys, Sessions.

variants.label: Group matrix
variants.notes: Users × groups grid: click cells to add or remove memberships, changes queue up and apply together. wheel (sudo) highlighted. Panel on the right in all: Reset password, Lock, Delete, and tabs Info, Groups (switches), SSH keys, Sessions.
